title: Mode tour
goal: Put it in Loiter, then Guided, then Return to launch, then Land.

steps.text: Choose LOITER in the Mode menu in the Control tab.
steps.hint: Loiter flies it forward like a plane and circles where it is.
Guided waits for you to tell it where to go.

steps.text: Press Return to launch in the Control tab.
steps.hint: Return to launch flies it home by itself.

steps.text: Press Land in the Control tab.
steps.hint: Land slows it to a hover and brings it straight down where it is.
